draft_en.subject: Alongside the Diva converters you carry - two converter numbers and an 8-port PoE
draft_en.body:
Hi Michael,

Over the past months you had a steady stream of product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 11 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the Diva media converters you carry, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, from single pieces, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: industrial Gigabit converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (fixed SC optional), -40 to 75 C - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD; PoE version - STI-111GP - $27.8; 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - STC-28DGGPM - $80.7. Racks and ONUs we do not carry. KC stays on your side.

One question: which converter configuration do your customers order most - SFP-slot or fixed SC, and at what monthly quantity?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
